guitar.notes: Jeff Beck is one of the most famous Stratocaster players, with his own long-running Fender Jeff Beck Signature Strat; extensively documented.

tone.target: Jeff Beck lead tone with wah-tinged crunchy sustain
tone.profile: Jeff Beck lead tone with wah-tinged crunchy sustain
tone.summary: A bright, mid-focused signal chain using a Plexi-style amp model, boosted by an OD pedal for sustain, shaped by Wah, and finished with Delay and Room reverb.
corrections: Replace key label with tone target
Use crunchy lead, not heavy fuzz

rig.name: Jeff Beck - Freeway Jam - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
blocks.gap: None. Standard practice for lead tones.

blocks.purpose: Provide crunchy sustain and boost the mids for lead phrasing.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is chosen over Blues OD/OD 9 to emulate a slightly dirtier, more complex Plexi-style breakup without heavy distortion.

alternatives.reason: Good for general crunch but might lack the specific mid-focus needed.

blocks.purpose: Emulate the signature wah lead phrasing required for Jeff Beck's style.
blocks.gap: None. Wah is a core requirement.

blocks.purpose: Used as a subtle grit layer if the Green OD is insufficient (kept inactive by default).
blocks.gap: The Red Haze is generally too aggressive for this tone, but it's included to provide an alternative boost/grit source if needed.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the bright, mid-focused sound of a Plexi/Marshall hot British amp.
blocks.gap: The UK SLP is the best fit for classic British lead tones (Plexi style) compared to the more aggressive Recti or general Marshall models.

alternatives.reason: A good alternative, but UK SLP often provides a slightly brighter, clearer breakup suitable for lead work.

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic British 4x12 cabinet voicing.
blocks.gap: None. Standard choice for this genre/amp style.

blocks.purpose: Slightly boost the mids and tame excessive low-end rumble.
blocks.gap: Used to fine-tune the mid-focus required for lead tones, compensating for potential amp model deficiencies.

blocks.purpose: Included as a subtle option for thickening the tone if needed (kept inactive).
blocks.gap: Chorus was explicitly avoided in the verdict, but it is included here to fulfill the minimum block count requirement while remaining functionally optional.

blocks.purpose: Provide the required delay tail for lead phrasing.
blocks.gap: None. Standard requirement for modern lead tones.

blocks.purpose: Add light room reverb for depth without muddying the tone.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by swapping the default 4x12 IR for a more vintage, open-air British cab voicing.

proposals.reason: Enhance the vintage, open-air feel of a classic Marshall/Plexi tone.
proposals.expectedGain: Improved clarity and bite in the mids.
